text: anna: Quick design check: our in-console help panel uses the word "Routes" in the primary CTA but the docs site uses "Endpoints". Users are getting mixed signals in onboarding. ben: I noticed this in support logs yesterday. People search for "endpoints" in the docs but the console nudges them to "routes". small friction. kira: Should we standardize to "Endpoints" across the board? it's the term our APIs use. anna: Prefer that. Proposal: add a tiny glossary anchor on docs and point in-panel CTAs to /docs/terminology#endpoints. ben: Accessibility: the help panel's close button loses focus styling when tabbing. also, the CTA link opens in the same tab which surprises some users. omar: On the tab behavior: we generally avoid forcing new tabs unless necessary. If we do open _blank, we must indicate it to screen reader users. e.g. aria-describedby pattern. kira: Good point. My UX preference: keep link target=_blank for docs because docs are external-ish, but add an inline hint and sr-only text: "opens in new tab". anna: Here's suggested microcopy for the panel: "Need details on Endpoints? Read the Endpoints docs (opens in new tab)". CTA button text: "Endpoints (docs)" to match docs exactly. ben: Also, contrast on the CTA button is marginal (light blue on white). We should validate against WCAG AA. omar: Accessibility checklist for the PR: 1) Add aria-label to close button, 2) visible focus ring on close and CTA, 3) aria-describedby for "opens in new tab", 4) keyboard Esc to close. I'll run axe on the updated markup. kira: Small content rule: don't use both "settings" and "configuration" interchangeably. choose one per concept. docs use "configuration" so console should match. anna: I'll create LIN-4350 to track copy + a11y + link behavior. I'll draft the console copy and update the help panel header from "Help" to "Help & Docs" so it's clearer. ben: Can someone make a short glossary doc with canonical terms? I'll throw together a list and link it from docs. anna: Timeline: ben will post glossary draft by tomorrow, kira will mock the updated panel, omar will add a11y notes to PR, anna will update links to include target and sr-only text. design-bot: Reminder: design sync 11:00am tomorrow; please include this as agenda item. :memo: ben: Mock callout: use a small external-link icon next to CTA and a visually-hidden span for screen readers. example: ```html Endpoints 🔗 opens in new tab ``` kira: That looks good. Also: if we keep CTA identical to docs phrasing, it reduces future drift. e.g., CTA label = "Endpoints" not "Routes". anna: Filing PR tracker now: LIN-4350 and I'll link the mock in the PR. cc @ben @kira @omar. ben: I'll upload glossary draft shortly. omar: I'll run accessibility tests once PR is ready. remember to include keyboard focus styles in the design tokens. anna: Thanks team. small change but should cut a bunch of support confusion. anna: LIN-4350: https://linear.app/redwood/issue/LIN-4350/in-console-help-terminology-and-a11y anna: PR: https://git.redwood.internal/p/console/merge/358 (internal) ben: :thumbsup:
